title: Round 3: airfield, dossier, drawing, board
question: Heavy and professional. Your jets family returns as a bolder dossier. All hero images are stand-ins.

options.label: Runway Paint
options.thesis: Slides are asphalt: threshold bars, centreline dashes, and monumental painted caps with one taxiway yellow.
options.viewport: Threshold bars across the top, a 232px two-line title in yellow and white, centreline dashes and a hero strip below.
options.risk: Very graphic; body slides need a calmer panel so text stays readable.

raised.raise: Rigid cells: every label and number sits in a fixed-width grid, so the data reads at a glance.

options.label: Jet Dossier
options.thesis: Half the slide is one processed image, half a black column with an extended heavy title and one champagne word.
options.viewport: Tall image left, ruled column right with coordinates, stacked title, one sentence.
options.risk: Dark on a bright projector, and the luxury register can undercut rigour if the image is glossy.

options.label: Title Block
options.thesis: Every slide is a drawing sheet: 4px frame, a ruled title block in the corner, a heavy Anton headline with one red word.
options.viewport: Framed sheet, huge condensed title, hero strip left, project title block bottom right.
options.risk: Looks like a worksheet if the title block gets too busy.

options.label: Split-flap Board
options.thesis: The title is the board: letters in fixed flap cells, amber for the key word.
options.viewport: Two rows of 62px flap cells spelling the title over a steel frame.
options.case: Wins on aviation clarity; holds audience axis weaker because flaps are tool-like and long titles strain the grid.
options.risk: Fixed cell width limits titles to about 12 letters a row.

options.label: HyperCard Stack
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful retro desktop, not heavy and professional.
options.kept: One card per idea: each slide holds exactly one claim.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white academic deck, navy headings, figure left, bullets right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other group by design.
